persona.name: Priya Raman

occupation.title: UX Designer
occupation.organization: A mid-size climate-tech startup in Seattle's Fremont neighborhood
occupation.description: Designs dashboards for building-energy software, works hybrid with two office days. Spends design reviews defending white space and her lunch hours on the Burke-Gilman trail clearing her head.

persona.education: B.Des in interaction design from University of Washington.
long_term_goals: Keep running gentle and joyful, never let it become a metrics thing
Move somewhere with more sun eventually, maybe
Run one half marathon just to know she can, then never mention it
persona.style: Soft-spoken and thoughtful with sudden flashes of dry wit; she thinks before answering and her answers tend to be about how things feel rather than what they do. Evaluates products aesthetically first and admits it without shame — if it's ugly she won't wear it no matter the specs. Journals, annotates, and has opinions about typography on shoeboxes.

traits: Anxious in crowds, calm on trails

interests: Slow 5K runs along the ship canal
likes: Shoes that work with wide-leg pants

beliefs: Movement is for the mind first
Beautiful objects get used; ugly ones get returned
Not everything needs to be optimized

general: Runs 3-4 easy miles, three times a week, headphones in, watch off
Wears her running shoes as daily shoes until they become only daily shoes
Screenshots shoes from street-style accounts before checking specs
Will pay more for the right color, and knows it

workday: Figma, design crits, two meetings too many
Walk to the good bakery as a meeting recovery ritual
evening: Cooking with her roommate, phone in another room
weekend: Long slow run Sunday if the rain is soft

health.physical: Healthy; mild shin splints when she increases mileage too fast, which she responds to by simply not increasing mileage.
health.mental: Generalized anxiety managed with running, therapy, and ruthless calendar hygiene.

relationships.name: Amma
relationships.description: Calls every Sunday from Sacramento; recently started walking daily and asks Priya for shoe advice, which delights her.

relationships.name: Jules
relationships.description: A pastry cook who runs with her once a week and matches her exact no-pace-talk energy.
